h1s.text: Powering projects that build a stronger, smarter future

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Powering projects that build a stronger, smarter" → 4 lines (8 words, 68px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Since 2003 · Karnataka · Goa · Gujarat" above "Powering projects that build a stronger,"; "Who we are" above "Built on trust for over 23 years"; "Three business verticals" above "Supply, execution and our own brand"; "PARKAN products" above "From our own range"; "Projects in action" above "Completed infrastructure work"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 5 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-red → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(210, 35, 42, 0.6) 0px 8px 2 | figure → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 0px 40px 80px -30px | div.g4 → rgba(14, 42, 82, 0.1) 0px 16px 40px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 7 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section 1440px | img 374px | img 274px | img 274px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 47 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 8 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Switzer and Switzer, but the page renders Inter, Inter Tight.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 4053px of nothing between: "Authorised distributor for India's leading electri"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 9 different lines (132px, 159px, 559px, 752px, 959px, 196px, 459px); the three most used hold only 59% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 7 screens in a row: "Built on trust for over 23 years"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 91 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Powering projects that build a stronger, smarter" → 3 lines (8 words, 40px); "13 branches across Karnataka, Goa and Gujarat" → 3 lines (7 words, 30px); "Planning a project or need a reliable supplier?" → 3 lines (8 words, 30px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section.sec at 2106px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 7 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "About Us", "Our Leadership Team", "Our Branches", "Why Work With Us"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
